theme_and_archetype.reasoning: For a B2B finance/analytics tool for Indian SMEs, Authority, clarity, and function-first design are paramount. The high-contrast Swiss style builds immediate trust and looks highly professional while maintaining a focus on completely secure data.

typography.rules: Never center-align large blocks of text. Ensure extreme contrast between heading weight and overline size. No Inter or default sans for headings.

color_palette.rules: Avoid soft gray mush. Use sharp pure white against solid zinc-100 backgrounds. Accent color must be used sparingly, mostly for primary CTAs and active states.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous spacing. p-8, p-12 inside containers. py-24 or py-32 for section padding.

grid_strategy.features: MODE A: 'Tetris' Grid for bento layouts. Asymmetrical spans (col-span-8, col-span-4).
grid_strategy.pricing: Equal 3-column grid but with the middle tier slightly elevated or visually dominant.

layout_and_spacing.alignment: Prioritize optical alignment and aggressive asymmetry. Left-align content where possible.
layout_and_spacing.borders: 1px solid border-zinc-200. No soft box-shadows. Use crisp borders to delineate spaces (Neo-Brutalist undertones).

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Crisp transformations. -translate-y-1 with a sharp, not blurry, shadow.
motion_and_interaction.animations: Subtle fade-in-up on scroll for major sections.

buttons.primary: bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-sm hover:bg-blue-700 font-bold px-8 py-3 transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-zinc-950 border border-zinc-950 rounded-sm hover:bg-zinc-100 font-bold px-8 py-3 transition-colors

header.style: bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-zinc-100 sticky top-0 z-50
header.elements: Logo, Features, Pricing, Testimonials, Login, Signup CTA

hero_image.description: Abstract modern data visualization, glowing connected nodes on a sleek white and soft gray background, representing secure B2B software syncing
hero_image.placement: Hero Section (Right side in split layout or layered beneath in hero)

feature_analytics.description: Minimalist 3D isometric dashboard interface, floating glass panels with clean charts and graphs

feature_security.description: Abstract metallic vault lock or secure data shield, minimalist 3D design
feature_security.placement: Features Section (Bento Grid - Security/Data sync feature)

feature_inventory.description: Modern warehouse logistics and inventory boxes, clean 3D isometric composition
feature_inventory.placement: Features Section (Bento Grid - Inventory Analytics feature)

content_strategy.hero_copy: Unlock full-scale analytics synced directly with Tally Prime. Built for Indian SMEs to drive sales, manage inventory, and securely optimize performance.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install custom fonts Cabinet Grotesk (headings) and Outfit (body) via Google Fonts or standard imports.
Use standard HTML + Tailwind for marketing layout (sections, asymmetric grids). Avoid over-relying on standard Card components.
Build a clear 3-tier pricing section based on the content strategy using INR prices.
Include a 'Trusted By' section with the provided logo URLs.
Ensure 'Login' button and 'Sign Up' CTA are prominent in the sticky header navigation.
Apply 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) using kebab-case role-based names.
Use Phosphor icons or Lucide-React for crisp, professional iconography.
The hero section should be narrative-driven, split-screen or asymmetric, with the hero_image providing a strong visual anchor.
Implement the 'Tetris' grid layout for the features section, mapping each feature text to one of the provided 3D feature images.
Ensure the entire app has a cohesive 'Swiss & High-Contrast' aesthetic: sharp edges (rounded-none or max rounded-sm), high contrast typography, minimal decorative fluff.
